passages.title: Recording 1
passages.text:
Man: Is that a new phone case?
Woman: Yes. I dropped my phone last week, so I thought I’d better protect it. Luckily the screen didn’t break, and the battery’s fine too. The only problem is that the camera doesn’t work any more, and I need it for my photography course.
Man: You should take it to the repair shop on Market Street. They’re really quick.

passages.title: Recording 2
passages.text:
Woman: Hello, I’m calling about my laptop. You were going to look at the keyboard.
Man: Yes. I’m afraid we can’t repair it, so we’ll need to put a new one in. Normally that’s seventy-five pounds altogether, sixty for the keyboard and fifteen for the work. But because you bought the laptop here, we won’t charge for the work.
Woman: So it’ll be sixty pounds?
Man: Less than that, actually. There’s fifteen pounds off all keyboards this month, so it’s just forty-five.
Woman: Great. Please go ahead.

passages.title: Recording 3
passages.text:
Woman: Have you found your tablet?
Man: Yes, thank goodness. I was sure I’d left it on the bus, so I phoned the bus company, but they didn’t have it. Then I remembered I’d used it in the café after I left the library.
Woman: And it was there?
Man: Yes. The waiter had kept it behind the counter for me.

passages.title: Recording 4
passages.text:
Man: So which one are you going to get?
Woman: I really liked the small laptop, but the screen’s too small for my design work.
Man: And the tablet with the keyboard? You could take it anywhere.
Woman: I don’t need to take it anywhere. I always work at home. So I’m going for the desktop computer. It’s got a huge screen, and it’s cheaper too.

passages.title: Recording 5
passages.text: Woman: Hello, this is Sarah from Fastline Broadband with a message for Mr Patel. You booked an engineer to look at your internet connection tomorrow at nine o’clock. I’m afraid he’s ill, so another engineer will come instead. She’s busy until half past eleven, so she can’t come in the morning, but she’ll be with you at two o’clock. Please call us back if that time is a problem.

passages.title: Recording 6
passages.text:
Man: Excuse me, do you sell chargers for this phone?
Woman: Yes, they’re over there, next to the phone cases.
Man: Great. I left mine at my hotel. Oh, and have you got any earphones?
Woman: Sorry, we’ve sold out. We’ll have more on Friday.
Man: Never mind. I’ll just take the charger, then.

passages.title: Recording 7
passages.text:
Man: How was your computer course?
Woman: Really good. I wanted to learn how to make a website for my business, but that course was full, so I did the one on photos instead. Now I can make all my holiday pictures look professional.
Man: Maybe you could do the website course next term.
Woman: Yes, I will. My son also wants me to try making computer games with him, but I don’t think so!

questions.question: What is wrong with the woman’s phone?
questions.explanation: The woman says "the camera doesn’t work any more". She also says "the screen didn’t break" and "the battery’s fine too".

questions.question: How much will the woman pay for the repair?
questions.explanation: The man says "it’s just forty-five" because there is "fifteen pounds off all keyboards this month". £75 is the normal price, and the woman wrongly thinks it will be £60 until he says "Less than that, actually".

questions.question: Where did the man find his tablet?
questions.explanation: He had used it "in the café after I left the library", and "The waiter had kept it behind the counter". The bus company "didn’t have it".

questions.question: Which computer is the woman going to buy?
options: c) A tablet with a keyboard
questions.explanation: The woman says "I’m going for the desktop computer". The laptop screen is "too small for my design work", and she does not need the tablet because "I always work at home".

questions.question: What time will the engineer arrive tomorrow?
questions.explanation: The message says "she’ll be with you at two o’clock". Nine o’clock was the time of the first booking, and the new engineer is "busy until half past eleven".

questions.question: What does the man buy?
questions.explanation: The man says "I’ll just take the charger, then". The phone cases are only where the chargers are, and the earphones have "sold out".

questions.question: What did the woman learn on her computer course?
options: c) How to build a website
questions.explanation: She "did the one on photos instead" and can now "make all my holiday pictures look professional". The website course "was full", and she does not want to make games with her son.
